bio.text: Katie Britt was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2022 and sworn in in 2023 as Alabama's first elected female Senator.
A native of Enterprise, Alabama, she earned a bachelor's degree in political science in 2004 and a J.D. in 2013, both from the University of Alabama.
She worked for Senator Richard Shelby, including as his chief of staff from 2016, and in 2018 became president and CEO of Alabama's business council.
She lives in Montgomery with her husband and two children.
